name: (Station Kit)
summary: A bare structural frame with snap-in modules (habitats, fuel tanks). Assembled from EX-3 flights; the orbital and lunar refuelling node the fleet is built around.
description: MX-79 is the modular orbital station kit: a bare structural frame with snap-in modules — habitats, fuel tanks, and more — assembled from EX-3 flights. MX-79 Alpha is the LEO depot and crew node; a Luna configuration is the lunar-orbit transfer node where the EX-4 hands off to the GX-04 lander. It is the refuelling node the whole orbital architecture depends on. Bridge between the MX and DX series and precursor to DX-93.
